title: Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) and Electronics Component Assembly (NSNs 5998-01-087-7775 P/N BH1994-2, 5998-01-072-2441 P/N BH1998-1, 5998-01-072-2412 P/N BH1999-1)
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.DLA AVIATION.DLA AVIATION WARNER ROBINS.DLA AVIATION AT WARNER ROBINS, GA
detail_text: Description The Government intends to release a firm fixed price request for proposal on or before 20 March 2026, sole source, to Howell Instruments Inc (CAGE: 98869) for the manufacture of the Circuit Card Assemblies (CCAs) and Electronics Component Assembly that are subcomponents for the ECS tester. 5998-01-087-7775 Qty 2 5998-01-072-2441 Qty 2 5998-01-072-2412 Qty 5 Impediment to Competition: The original equipment manufacturer for this item is Howell Instruments Inc (CAGE: 98869), which maintains its configuration by part number and software version. The Government does not own any data, drawings, schematics, or any other releasable technical data in support of this requirement. As a result, Howell Instruments Inc is the only known source with adequate knowledge of the CCAs and Electronics Component Assembly performance requirements and possession of the required technical data and capabilities needed to produce this item and ensure compatibility with the equipment. DISCLAIMER This is for informational purposes only. This is not a request for proposal. It does not constitute a solicitation and shall not be construed as a commitment by the government. Responses in any form are not offers, and the government is under no obligation to award a contract because of this announcement. No funds are available to pay for preparation of responses to this announcement. Any information submitted by respondents to this technical description is strictly voluntary.
